name: imagination
description: Drive your local Imagination Is All You Need studio (image, video, audio, 3D): find tools and models, quote, run with a server-enforced quote and budget, follow jobs, fetch results.

api_url.title: Studio API
api_url.description: Where the app's API runs (npm run dev)

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: core (default), library, admin, canvas, legacy or all, comma-separated

budget_usd.title: Budget cap (USD)
budget_usd.description: Optional: a budget for the whole session; runs over it are refused before anything is sent. Empty = none

spend.title: Paid runs
spend.description: ask (approve each paid run, with its price), allow or block
